# raff_role (Resource)

Manages a custom IAM role. System roles (Owner, Admin, Member, Operator, etc.) are immutable and managed by the platform — only custom roles can be created here.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Set of permission keys (e.g. vm.create, project.members.view). Run `raff permission list` for the catalog.
- `scope` (String) account or project.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe identifier.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Role description.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_system` (Boolean)
- `updated_at` (String)
